SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — ROUTE CAPABILITY CENSUS (ledger req_0015). The user's methodology, verbatim: "capture all the current routes in place. mark them down, then go thru each one, e2e, capture what did it do? and then from here, we verify that our new singular multi-faced route is accounting for it."

You are one of several lanes each walking assigned routes E2E and producing capability captures in ONE uniform schema, so the workbench can be verified against a complete map. Other lanes are doing other routes concurrently — touch ONLY your assigned routes' census files; do not edit WORKBENCH.md (the master index gets assembled after, single-writer), do not edit any route code, do not edit shell/ or editors/workbench/ source (a build lane is active there).

METHOD per route — E2E means RUN IT, not just read it:
1. Boot your own host instance (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 tools/rjit ship hmsc-int, or your own dev run — NEVER the user's session) and physically walk the route: click every control, press every hotkey, open every overlay, drag every draggable, trigger every save/load, observe every visual mode. Screenshot anything whose behavior is hard to describe.
2. Cross-check against the route's source: every interaction you found gets its file:line; every interaction IN THE CODE you didn't find live gets walked again or honestly marked unverified-live.
3. Persistence walk: do a thing → hot reload → leave-and-return → does it survive? Which stream/twig/draft carries it? Capture per behavior.

OUTPUT — one file per route: cart/hmsc-int/editors/workbench/census/<route>.md with EXACTLY this shape:
```
# CENSUS — /<route> (e2e walked <date>, session <id>)
Status today: <live route summary, 2-3 sentences: what is this FOR>
## Capabilities (e2e-walked, line-referenced)
| id | what it does (user-visible behavior) | how (control/hotkey/gesture) | code | persistence | workbench accounting |
| C1 | ... | ... | file:line | stream/twig/none | ACCOUNTED <slot> / PENDING <ledger step> / UNPLANNED |
## Hotkey inventory
## Persistence inventory (what survives reload, via what)
## Oddities/bugs found while walking (report, do not fix)
## Unverified-live rows (code says it exists, could not trigger; why)
```
"workbench accounting" rows: ACCOUNTED = exists in /workbench today (name the slot: roster/panel/stage/lens/action); PENDING = covered by a planned WORKBENCH.md step (name it); UNPLANNED = no plan accounts for it — these are the census's whole reason to exist; never silently drop one.

Commit per route file, explicit paths, push. P4 tests are NOT required for census docs. The census is read-only with respect to the app — zero behavior changes, zero fixes (bugs found go in the Oddities section; the supervisor routes them).

DONE BAR per route: the census file with every section filled, the walk actually performed (your screenshots/notes prove it), UNPLANNED rows called out loudly at the top of your report.
YOUR ASSIGNMENT (pane 4): /items and /voxels. Marker: CENSUS-ITEMS-0606. Note their entanglement honestly (ITEMSCULPT made voxel blockouts the item input) — two census files, cross-references welcome.
